bio.text: Mai Vang, a Democrat, has represented District 8 on the Sacramento City Council since 2020 and is a candidate for California's 7th Congressional District in 2026.
She earlier served on the Sacramento City Unified School District board from 2016 to 2020.
According to her campaign website, she is the daughter of Hmong refugees and was born and raised in Sacramento.
She earned a bachelor's degree from the University of San Francisco and a graduate degree from the University of California, Los Angeles.
